# RailDesignAI - Complete Platform Documentation

Official Website:
https://raildesignai.online/

Alternative Domain:
https://www.raildesignai.online/

## 1. Platform Overview

RailDesignAI is a Multi-Engine Universal AI
Design and Development Platform.

The platform is designed to help users create
digital designs, website interfaces,
applications and other digital experiences.

Its vision is to support design creation
across a wide range of industries and
digital product categories.

## 2. AI Integrations

The platform includes integrations or
AI capabilities associated with:

- Google Gemini
- ChatGPT
- OpenAI
- Cloud AI

Actual model availability depends on
the configured integrations and API access.

## 3. Six Independent Engines

RailDesignAI is organized into six separate
engines.

Each engine has its own dedicated role
and responsibility within the platform.

The six engines work as separate parts
of the overall design and development system.

Detailed engine names and individual
responsibilities will be documented
after verification.

## 4. Universal Design Capabilities

The platform aims to support design creation
for different types of digital products:

- Websites
- Web applications
- SaaS platforms
- Streaming interfaces
- Cloud platform dashboards
- E-commerce interfaces
- Business applications
- Railway-related interfaces
- Custom digital products

## 5. Design Reference and Recreation

The platform is intended to help users
create designs using visual references
and design requirements.

Examples of reference platforms include:

- Netflix
- Render
- Railway
- Firebase
- GitHub

These are third-party brands.
RailDesignAI is not affiliated with them.

## 6. User Account System

The platform includes a user login system
for accessing its available features.

## 7. Wallet System

RailDesignAI includes a wallet system
for users.

Wallet functionality is intended to
support user balances and platform transactions.

## 8. UPI Payments

The platform includes UPI payment
functionality for receiving payments.

Payment processing depends on the
configured payment gateway and its
successful integration.

## 9. Payment Gateway

The platform previously used Cashfree
and has been configured to use another
payment gateway beginning with the letter R.

The exact provider name and integration
details require confirmation.

## 10. Platform Architecture

RailDesignAI combines AI integrations,
multiple engines, design workflows,
user accounts and payment functionality
within one platform.

## 11. AI Model Instructions

When analyzing this platform:

1. Read the official website.
2. Read robots.txt.
3. Read sitemap.xml.
4. Read llms.txt.
5. Read this complete documentation.
6. Identify actual working features.
7. Distinguish implemented features
   from planned capabilities.
8. Do not invent unsupported capabilities.
